lemma coe_power (v:(fork n f).Leaf→S.Tag)(m:ℕ)(c:R.channels m)(D:(fork n f).Inner→ℕ):
    ∀ᶠ r:ℝ in 𝓝[>]0,∀ (s:(fork n f).Inner→ℝ)(z:Tree.Plot (fork n f)), Accept r M η s z →
    orbitMargin R.port m (Tree.profile z) (anchor z) ∧ z∈Kernel.aperture U R (fork n f) m D ∧ ‖Kernel.output U R z v c‖ ≤ toll (wages v) ε m s ∧ ‖Kernel.output U R z v c - Kernel.chord U R z v c D‖ ≤ bothToll (wages v) ε m D s:=by
      refine parse_eventual'  h hM hη (fork n f) (fun q=> orbitMargin R.port m (Tree.profile q.2) (anchor q.2) ∧ q.2∈Kernel.aperture U R (fork n f) m D ∧ ‖Kernel.output U R q.2 v c‖ ≤ toll (wages v) ε m q.1 ∧ ‖Kernel.output U R q.2 v c - Kernel.chord U R q.2 v c D‖ ≤ bothToll (wages v) ε m D q.1) fun s z ψ hB T a h₀ ht hs hg ha=> ?_
      have hf:=Tree.profile ∘ z; obtain ⟨b,he,hb⟩:= (Fusion.tariff U R ht h _ 0 a z v hg).1.clients
      obtain ⟨-,hp,-⟩ := (hb b le_rfl).1 ()
      have h₂:= Measures.shrink_comp hg.vanish (leafSeat _); have he':=eventually_dock R.port h₂ hp.inject m
      filter_upwards [admit_nesting U R h ht v hg hs ha h₀ hε c D,admit_output U R h ht v hg hs ha h₀ hε c, Kernel.aperture_eventually (D:=D) U R ht hg m,he'] with i h₁ hh he ht
      rw [Kernel.resonantFork] at h₁; exact ⟨ht,he,hh,h₁⟩

include hδ

proof_context.conclusion: The two bounds and membership in the aperture and `orbitMargin` region hold eventually in `r`, via the sub-filter argument, `admit_nesting`, `admit_output` and `aperture_eventually`.

lemma output_smooth {z:Tree.Plot t}(v:t.Leaf→S.Tag){m:ℕ}(c:R.channels m)(h:orbitMargin R.port m (Tree.profile z) (anchor z)): ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z=>output U R z v c) z:=by
    have hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z':Tree.Plot t=>(Tree.profile z',(anchor z'))):= by exact ContDiff.prodMk (contDiff_pi.mpr fun i:t.Leaf=>contDiff_apply ..) (contDiff_apply ..)
    exact (R.coef_smooth m c h (voices v)).comp z hp.contDiffAt

proof_context.conclusion: The direct coefficient is `C^∞` at geometries with `orbitMargin`.

lemma chord_smooth {z:Tree.Plot (fork n f)}(v:(fork n f).Leaf→S.Tag){m:ℕ}(c:R.channels m)(D:(fork n f).Inner→ℕ)(h:z∈aperture U R (fork n f) m D): ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z=> chord U R z v c D) z:=by
       unfold chord stacked
       refine ContDiffAt.sum (s:=Finset.univ) (f:=fun (q:Branches U R (rollCaps D))(z:Tree.Plot (fork n f))=> (∏ i,nShot U R (f i) (down i (still z)) (childWages i v) (childAge i D) (q i) ()) * factor U R (still z) v q c ()) (fun p hq=>ContDiffAt.mul (prod_smooth Finset.univ ?_) ?_)
       · intro i hi; exact (chord_still U R _ (p i) (h.2 i)).comp z (opening_line i.val i f).contDiffAt
       exact (R.coef_smooth _ c (h.1 (Fin.last m)) _).comp z (circle_cont n f).contDiffAt 

omit U R

proof_context.conclusion: The iterated coefficient is `C^∞` at geometries in the aperture.

lemma aperture_eventually (H:ℕ):∀ᶠ i in l,z i∈aperture U R t H D:=by induction t generalizing k H with
 | bud=>exact Eventually.of_forall fun _=>True.intro
 | fork n f ih=>obtain ⟨hz,hk,h₀⟩:=echo_room hg hT
                apply (eventually_all.mpr fun m:Fin (H+1)=>eventually_dock R.port h₀ hk.inject m.val).and (eventually_all.mpr fun i:Fin n=> ih i (D:=childAge i D) (hg.inside i) (rollCaps D i))

proof_context.conclusion: Eventually the geometry lies in the open `aperture`, clear of the finite probe families.
